changes.issue: Gradle 9.8.1 remains affected by the November catalog code-generation and daemon-registry advisories, including one critical and two high findings. This was an omission in the earlier dependency review.
changes.change: Upgrade the complete wrapper to 9.9.1, regenerate the launch scripts/JAR with the official distribution, verify the distribution and wrapper JAR SHA256 values against first-party sources, retain URL validation and add an isolated valid/invalid catalog regression. The non-executable invalid value is accepted by 9.8.1 but rejected during validation by 9.9.1.

changes.issue: The selected application KGP 2.2.10 falls below the KAPT unsafe-deserialisation fix. Merely compiling RN build plugins with 2.4.21 does not select the application plugin.
changes.change: Select stable Kotlin 2.4.21 and explicitly version the root buildscript plugin dependency. Pin the supported AsyncStorage KSP override to 2.3.14: its bundled lookup otherwise falls back to KSP 1.0.28 and fails native task creation against Kotlin 2.4. Retain Room and its generated legacy-storage migration; do not bypass processing. The final native matrix recompiles the migration processor and app. KSP 2.3.14 also fixes the concurrent execution regression in 2.3.13. Keep AGP 9.2.1, Java 21, SDK/NDK and supported devices unchanged. Record and validate the actual resolved application KGP in CI; reject an older or unverified selection. The vendor fully-tested Gradle range ends at 9.7; later versions are allowed with possible warnings, so the security-required Gradle 9.9.1 combination is verified by the native matrix rather than described as vendor-certified.

changes.issue: Failed-load, language-hierarchy and plural-rule caches can grow with unlimited language/namespace input. Server middleware is the primary exposed upstream scenario; this app does not contain that middleware.
changes.change: Upgrade 27.1.1 to 27.1.2. Exercise over 1,000 failed loads and generated language codes against the actual installed library. Verify bounded caches and that offline translations, interpolation, empty strings and custom country locale IDs still work using the app’s cleanCode/fallback policies. The first test fails on 27.1.1 and both pass on 27.1.2.

changes.issue: TurboModule permission requests may run on the native-modules thread while Android changes the UI hierarchy. Duplicate/cyclic iOS delegate chains can also recurse.
changes.change: Upgrade NotifyKit 10.10.0 to 10.10.1. Its Android POST_NOTIFICATIONS request moves onto the UI thread while preserving rejection behaviour. Its iOS callback forwarding contains synchronous delegate cycles. Run the package’s real Android main-thread/error-path regression on API 33 and 36 in CI. CocoaPods inputs are regenerated on macOS; the legacy alarm reader and notification IDs are not rewritten.

changes.issue: The native constantsToExport override had an implicitly unwrapped optional return type rather than the required non-optional dictionary.
changes.change: Upgrade Lottie RN 7.5.0 to 7.5.1. Keep the returned VERSION value, animation APIs, splash/manual-dismiss behaviour and lottie-ios 4.6.0. The native package changes only the override signature and package version.

changes.issue: The original 2.15.1 selection predates native view-ID, Metal ownership and temporary wrapper-lifetime backports, plus pixel-grid/retained-buffer corrections. The global latest tag obscures maintained 2.x patches.
changes.change: Upgrade to 2.15.5 within the supported Victory 43 / Skia 2 pairing, retaining Ganesh and older-device support. Do not introduce Skia 3/Graphite or raise the app minimum OS. The lock also updates CanvasKit WASM 0.41.0 to 0.41.1 for the package’s web path. Native rendering/physical GPU acceptance remains distinct from compilation.

changes.issue: setup-java 6.2.0 embeds an affected fast-xml-parser line.
changes.change: Pin setup-java 6.3.0 to verified immutable commit d1374f8ac74474200d16ef8ecee22c7ae7a51880. Its bundled parser is 5.12.0. Explicitly keep problem-matcher enabled because this release changes the default; compiler annotations and the Java 21 selection are retained.

changes.issue: An npm audit cannot verify Maven runtime packages or establish which Kotlin plugin Gradle actually selected. Partial scans can otherwise appear clean.
changes.change: Add a read-only inventory of all ten release runtime classpaths plus root buildscript coordinates. Reject incomplete resolution, empty/missing variants and unpatched selected KGP. Query exact runtime coordinates plus the selected KGP against OSV and fail on advisory matches, malformed/partial/paginated responses or request failures. Preserve the inventory/report as CI artifacts. Other buildscript, Apple/C++ and service coverage remains explicitly excluded.

changes.area: Main-branch dependency comparison and acceptance follow-up
changes.issue: The prior comparison used PR #1115 rather than current main; some console inspections and actual access blockers were not recorded in the consolidated report.
changes.change: Compare all direct main/fixes selections and both locked npm graphs, inspect newer within-major candidates as well as latest tags, check immutable Actions and Ruby/native constraints, record fresh registry/signature/Ruby results, and document the new bounded Firebase observations. Keep production/device/governance acceptance separate from source fixes.

native_ci: Required on the final published source. Consult the corresponding commit run and consolidated report; the lock-only run is not application acceptance.
